package.name: Finco1 What Changed Delta Indicator Governance Review Pack

pr_586_fact_record.title: Phase 25B-3 — Runtime "What Changed" Delta Indicator (UI + minimal metadata-persistence rotation)
pr_586_fact_record.scope_classification: UI + minimal metadata-persistence rotation. NOT UI-only, NOT read-only in the strict sense.
pr_586_fact_record.b43_does_not_claim: B43 does not claim Agent B has performed a visual review. B43 does not claim Agent B has approved the persistence implementation. B43 records the governance / evidence requirements only.

ui_panel_scope.trigger: After editing and re-running a Generic Solar / Generic Wind scenario, the scenario-version-history panel shows a compact 'What changed since previous run?' comparison.
ui_panel_scope.helper_module_properties: pure: no DB, no I/O, no time, no random

persistence_rotation.behavior: Stamps the previous run summary into replay_metadata.previous_run_summary before overwriting last_run_summary_json

replay_metadata_optional_keys.purpose: The previous run's summary. Used by the What Changed panel to compute deltas. Rotated on each new run.
The run before the previous run's summary. Used by the What Changed panel for multi-run comparison. Rotated on each new run.
An ISO timestamp of the previous run. Used by the What Changed panel to display when the previous run occurred.

factory_output_byte_identical_claim.claim: Factory project run summary output is byte-identical to the pre-Phase-25B-3 path.
factory_output_byte_identical_claim.scope: factory project run summary output only (not user project output)

exploratory_banner_requirement.purpose: Make it clear that the deltas are not Excel-parity validated.
exploratory_banner_requirement.without_banner_risk: Generic deltas could be misread as Excel-parity validated

what_must_be_visually_reviewed: The What Changed panel renders correctly for a Generic Solar scenario with at least 2 runs.
The What Changed panel renders correctly for a Generic Wind scenario with at least 2 runs.
The What Changed panel does NOT render for a factory project (TUHO / Oborovo).
The exploratory banner is visible for Generic Solar / Generic Wind scenarios.
The 10 KPIs are displayed with the correct units (pct, x, kEUR).
The delta values are computed correctly (subtraction + percentage).
The panel is accessible (keyboard navigation, screen reader).
The panel is responsive (desktop, tablet, mobile).
what_must_be_regression_tested: The factory project run summary output is byte-identical to the pre-Phase-25B-3 path.
The user project run summary output includes the new What Changed data.
The replay_metadata rotation is correct for runs 1, 2, 3, 4+.
Other replay_metadata keys are preserved across writes.
The exploratory banner is rendered for Generic Solar / Generic Wind scenarios.
The panel is gated on card.is_user_project.
The parity-core lock is unchanged for TUHO and Oborovo.
No model output drift for any project.
what_should_block_pilot_demo_if_broken: The factory project run summary output is NOT byte-identical to the pre-Phase-25B-3 path. Hard blocker.
The user project run summary output is corrupted (e.g., NaN, infinity, missing fields). Hard blocker.
The exploratory banner is missing for Generic Solar / Generic Wind scenarios. Hard blocker.
The panel renders for a factory project (TUHO / Oborovo). Hard blocker.
The parity-core lock is broken for TUHO or Oborovo. Hard blocker.
Any model output drift is detected. Hard blocker.
Any schema migration is performed without explicit governance approval. Hard blocker.
Any new financial formula is introduced without explicit governance approval. Hard blocker.
global_notes: Agent B does not approve code correctness. Agent B does not validate persistence implementation. Agent B records governance / evidence requirements only.
The What Changed panel is a UX explanation feature, not a valuation or investment tool. The deltas are explanatory indicators, not guaranteed accuracy claims.
The What Changed panel does not provide investment advice. The What Changed panel does not provide guaranteed returns.
The exploratory banner is required for generic_solar / generic_wind. Without the banner, the generic deltas could be misread as Excel-parity validated.
Claude review / post-51T review are separate workstreams. They are referenced only as review evidence, not external validation or certification.
